ms_short: Download torrents and magnet links on Windows with no ads, no account and no analytics. Click a magnet link in your browser and it opens right in the app. Set speed limits, queue downloads and choose where files are saved.
intro_ms: Torrent Client App is a free, open-source BitTorrent client and torrent downloader for Windows 10 and 11. Click a magnet link in your browser or double-click a .torrent file, and the download starts. No ads, no account, no bundled offers.
intro_play: Torrent Client is a free, open-source BitTorrent app and torrent downloader for Android. Tap a magnet link in your browser or open a .torrent file, and the download starts. No ads, no account, no bundled offers.
b_open_ms: Open magnet links from your browser and .torrent files from File Explorer.
b_open_play: Open magnet links and .torrent files from your browser, file manager and other apps.
b_stats: See progress, download and upload speed, seeds, peers and time remaining.
b_controls: Start, pause, stop and remove transfers one at a time or all at once.
b_background_play: Downloads keep running in the background with a progress notification.
b_resume: Transfers that were running resume automatically after a restart.
b_wifi_ms: Wi-Fi-only mode keeps transfers off mobile broadband and resumes them when you reconnect.
b_wifi_play: Wi-Fi-only mode pauses transfers on mobile data and resumes them on Wi-Fi.
b_awake_play: Optional keep-awake setting for long transfers with the screen off.
b_limits: Global and per-torrent download and upload limits.
b_queue: Limit active downloads and seeds, with seeding ratio and time limits.
b_folder_play: Copy finished downloads to your phone's Downloads folder with one tap.
p_privacy: No advertising or analytics SDKs. As with any BitTorrent app, trackers and peers can see your IP address; route supported traffic through your own SOCKS5 proxy if you prefer.
b_libronest: Send finished audiobook downloads to LibroNest.
b_themes: System, light and dark themes, and 24 interface languages.
b_arm_ms: Native x64 and ARM64 builds, including Snapdragon-powered Surface Pro and Surface Laptop.
foot_ms: Transfers run while the app is open and the PC is awake. Download and share only content you have the right to use.
foot_play: Android battery settings may limit background activity. Download and share only content you have the right to use.
